name: securecoder
description: Security-aware code generation: contract-preserving security constraints, SAST on every edit (syntax, semgrep, bandit; CodeQL on demand), and a guided remediation loop.

interface.shortDescription: Security checks and guided fixes for the code Codex writes
interface.longDescription: SecureCoder adds security constraints before code generation, scans every edited file with fast static analyzers (syntax, semgrep, bandit), offers deep CodeQL analysis on demand, and drives a fix-and-recheck remediation loop with retry limits. Run $securecoder:securecoder to view and change settings.
defaultPrompt: Use SecureCoder to scan the files I changed and fix any security findings.
Use SecureCoder to write this feature securely, then run a deep CodeQL check.
